messages.content: I want an API that takes an IP address and returns company data with contact information if available.

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve data. This function is commonly used for API calls and web scraping. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The Date Nager API provides access holiday information for over 100 countries, including the ability to query for long weekends. It leverages ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to tailor the search to your specific region of interest. More information can be found in https://date.nager.at/Api

headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most popular public APIs that accept an IP address (or a CIDR block) and return business‑related data such as the owning company, contact details, and other metadata. All of them expose a simple REST endpoint that you can hit with a `GET` request; most of them also offer SDKs or client libraries in several languages. | # | Service | Key Features | Typical Endpoint | Example Call | Notes | |---|---------|--------------|------------------|--------------|-------| | 1 | **ipinfo.io** | • Company name, AS number, and owner
• Contact email & phone (if available)
• Rich JSON payload with location, carrier, and more | `https://ipinfo.io//json` | `curl https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json?token=YOUR_TOKEN` | Free tier: 50k req/month. Paid plans unlock contact fields. | | 2 | **ipstack.com** | • Organization name, domain, and ASN
• Contact email & phone (paid plans)
• Geo‑location, currency, timezone | `https://api.ipstack.com/?access_key=YOUR_KEY&fields=ip,hostname,organization,asn,contact_email,contact_phone` | `curl https://api.ipstack.com/8.8.8.8?access_key=YOUR_KEY&fields=ip,hostname,organization,asn,contact_email,contact_phone` | Free tier: 10k req/month. | | 3 | **ipapi.co** | • Organization, ASN, and contact info (paid)
• Country, region, city, postal code | `https://ipapi.co//json/` | `curl https://ipapi.co/8.8.8.8/json/` | Free tier: 30k req/day. | | 4 | **ipgeolocation.io** | • Company name, domain, and contact email
• ASN, ISP, and organization
• Geo‑data, timezone, currency | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_KEY&ip=8.8.8.8` | `curl https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_KEY&ip=8.8.8.8` | Free tier: 1k req/day. | | 5 | **ipwhois.io** | • Organization, ASN, and contact email (paid)
• Geo‑location, carrier | `https://ipwhois.app/json/` | `curl https://ipwhois.app/json/8.8.8.8` | Free tier: 10k req/day. | | 6 | **ip2location.com** | • Company name, domain, and contact email (paid)
• ASN, ISP, and organization
• Geo‑data, timezone, currency | `https://api.ip2location.com/v2/?key=YOUR_KEY&package_id=WS-DB-IP-WS-1&format=json&ip=8.8.8.8` | `curl https://api.ip2location.com/v2/?key=YOUR_KEY&package_id=WS-DB-IP-WS-1&format=json&ip=8.8.8.8` | Free tier: 1k req/day. | | 7 | **ipqualityscore.com** | • Company name, domain, and contact email (paid)
• ASN, ISP, and organization
• Geo‑data, timezone, currency | `https://www.ipqualityscore.com/api/json/ip/YOUR_API_KEY/8.8.8.8` | `curl https://www.ipqualityscore.com/api/json/ip/YOUR_API_KEY/8.8.8.8` | Free tier: 10k req/day. | | 8 | **ipdata.co** | • Organization, ASN, and contact email (paid)
• Geo‑location, carrier, and timezone | `https://api.ipdata.co/8.8.8.8?api-key=YOUR_KEY` | `curl https://api.ipdata.co/8.8.8.8?api-key=YOUR_KEY` | Free tier: 1k req/day. | --- ### How to pick the right one | Criteria | ipinfo.io | ipstack.com | ipapi.co | ipgeolocation.io | ipwhois.io | |----------|-----------|-------------|----------|------------------|------------| | **Free tier limits** | 50k / month | 10k / month | 30k / day | 1k / day | 10k / day | | **Contact fields in free tier** | No | No | No | No | No | | **Contact fields in paid tier** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | **ASN / ASN owner** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | **Geo‑location accuracy** | Very good | Good | Good | Good | Good | | **Ease of integration** | Simple JSON, optional SDKs | Simple JSON, optional SDKs | Simple JSON, optional SDKs | Simple JSON, optional SDKs | Simple JSON, optional SDKs | | **Pricing (paid)** | $50 / month (10k req) | $9 / month (10k req) | $19 / month (30k req) | $19 / month (1k req) | $9 / month (10k req) | --- ### Sample Python snippet (using `requests`) ```python import requests def get_company_info(ip, api_key=None): url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json" params = {"token": api_key} if api_key else {} resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=5) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() return { "ip": data.get("ip"), "hostname": data.get("hostname"), "company": data.get("org"), # e.g., "AS15169 Google LLC" "asn": data.get("asn"), "contact_email": data.get("contact_email"), "contact_phone": data.get("contact_phone"), "city": data.get("city"), "region": data.get("region"), "country": data.get("country"), } print(get_company_info("8.8.8.8", api_key="YOUR_TOKEN")) ``` Replace the URL and parameters if you choose another provider. All of the services above return a JSON object that contains fields like `org`, `asn`, `contact_email`, and `contact_phone` when you have a paid plan. --- ### Quick start checklist 1. **Sign up** for an account on the chosen provider’s website. 2. **Get an API key** (most free tiers still require a key). 3. **Read the docs** for the exact field names you need. 4. **Make a test request** using `curl` or Postman to confirm you receive the expected JSON. 5. **Integrate** into your application using the snippet above or the provider’s SDK. --- #### Bottom line If you only need the company name and ASN, the free tier of any of these services will do. If you need actual contact details (email, phone), you’ll need to upgrade to a paid plan—most providers offer a small “starter” plan that gives you 10k–30k requests per month at a reasonable price. Happy coding!
